Internal only; never rendered. REVISION 2 (2026-09-30, Martha): glass-bottom boat is 2h30 for every cohort (A/B now 12:00-2:30); all programming at Pennekamp for now; school provides its own buses (drop-off 9:00 AM, pick-up 5:00 PM); REEF-arranged transportation between Pennekamp and campus is under exploration and NOT confirmed. location: John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park, Key Largo
summary: A one-day marine science program for 115 students, organized into {{cohort_count_word}} cohorts rotating through hands-on experiences led by REEF educators, from {{arrival_time}} to {{departure_time}}.

days.title: One Day on the Reef
days.theme: Students rotate in {{cohort_count_word}} cohorts through {{experience_count_word}} hands-on experiences led by REEF educators, from {{arrival_time}} to {{departure_time}}.
studentsWill: Observe living coral reef habitat and marine life from the glass-bottom boat.
Learn and practice the fish identification and survey methods REEF's citizen scientists use.
Investigate invasive lionfish anatomy and adaptations through a guided dissection.
Explore how marine ecosystems function and why some Florida Keys species are endangered.
Connect what they see to REEF's ongoing reef conservation and invasive-species work.

logistics.transportation: Your school provides bus transportation to and from John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park. The group arrives on three buses for a {{arrival_time}} drop-off, and the buses return to pick up students at {{departure_time}}. Park entrance fees for all three buses are included. Transportation between the park and other locations is still being explored and is not part of this proposal.
logistics.familyTransportation: Students travel to and from the park by school bus, with drop-off at {{arrival_time}} and pick-up at {{departure_time}}. Your school will share departure and return times.
logistics.meals: Lunch is not provided. Students and chaperones bring a packed lunch, and each cohort has a scheduled picnic lunch at the park. REEF staff can recommend delivery options.
logistics.lunch: Packed lunches from home. Each cohort eats at its own scheduled time in the park picnic area.
logistics.arrival: Buses arrive at John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park for a {{arrival_time}} start.
logistics.transitions: Short gaps between activities are transition time for moving between the marina, the picnic area and program areas. This is a planning schedule, so exact timing may be refined before the program.
logistics.departure: The program day ends at {{departure_time}}, when buses return to pick up students.
